## Mercy Review Focus

- [ ] Backend/core behavior preserves the FastAPI shared intelligence boundary.
- [ ] Web changes preserve auth/session behavior and the `/api/core/*` proxy.
- [ ] Office add-in changes preserve auth handoff, redacted local storage, and manifest readiness.
- [ ] Vault, matter, document, citation, and source-traceability flows remain tenant-scoped.
- [ ] Legal output still shows D.C. grounding, citation verification, and attorney-review requirements.
- [ ] File/document handling, PII redaction, retention posture, and audit traces are not weakened.
- [ ] CI, security, and verification impact is documented.
